================================================================================
Higher-precedence keyword keeps its follower while word is valid
================================================================================
rgb(1)
---
(program (rgb))

================================================================================
Unrelated word remains a word
================================================================================
otherxyz
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Retained keyword in the unsafe state
================================================================================
other rgb
---
(program (word) (rgb))

================================================================================
Missing closing delimiter is rejected
:error
================================================================================
rgb(1
---
(program (rgb) (MISSING ")"))

================================================================================
Unexpected argument is rejected
:error
================================================================================
rgb(2)
---
(ERROR (rgb) (word))

================================================================================
Explicit keyword precedence still outranks longer word matching
:error
================================================================================
rgbxyz
---
(program (ERROR (rgb)) (word))
